summary: Allow Workspace PR Linux jobs to use a dedicated Namespace profile with a provider-enforced concurrency limit, preserving owned choices and merge routing.

replay.detail: CI routing only; no production replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or client contract changes.

rules.detail: No runtime authority or claim-rule changes; existing fork isolation and runner reservations stay in place.

compatibility.detail: Inactive while CI_PR_NAMESPACE_PROFILE is unset. A qualified dedicated PR profile changes only Namespace fallback routing; merge groups, already-queued exact PR heads at selection, and non-PR events retain existing routing. Queue lookup failures preserve existing routing.

downtime.detail: No service restart or production downtime. Existing CI jobs keep their frozen labels.

manual.detail: A workspace administrator must provision and qualify the dedicated 8vCPU/16GiB PR profile with concurrent runners set to 15 before CI_PR_NAMESPACE_PROFILE is set. Record actual tools/KVM/profile and before/after queue evidence; source checks alone do not activate or qualify the provider cap.

recovery.detail: Clear the owned repository variable to restore prior routing for new selections. Keep the profile available for existing queued jobs; do not cancel required jobs or delete the profile as automatic rollback.
